items.title: Christian Watson: Questionable to return Wednesday
items.text:
Watson is being evaluated for a concussion and is questionable to return to Wednesday's game against the Rams.

items.title: Christian Watson: Injured again versus Los Angeles
items.text:
Watson (undisclosed) appeared to sustain an injury after taking a hard hit in the second quarter of Wednesday's game against the Rams, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.
